source_excerpt: Upon the USB being plugged in the system shall be able to be deployed and operational in less than 1 minute.

evidence_span.text: Upon the USB being plugged in

clean_requirement: After a USB is plugged in, the system shall be deployed and operational in less than 60 seconds.
smelly_requirement: After a USB is plugged in, the system shall be deployed and operational quickly.
removed_condition: The measurable deployment deadline of less than 60 seconds is removed.
contamination_notes: The source gives a concrete one-minute bound. The clean form converts it to seconds for deterministic execution; the smelly form replaces the bound with an untestable adverb.
licensing_notes: The ARTA repository is MIT-licensed, but the original GAMMA-J Web Store specification may have separate copyright terms. Verify the original document terms before publishing excerpts beyond this research repository.

smell.injection_rule: replace the one-minute upper bound with the vague adverb quickly

reference_implementations.clean:
def evaluate(usb_plugged, elapsed_seconds):
    return usb_plugged and elapsed_seconds < 60
reference_implementations.smelly_plausible:
def evaluate(usb_plugged, elapsed_seconds):
    return usb_plugged and elapsed_seconds < 120

test_gen.criterion: be operational only when USB is plugged and elapsed time is below 60 seconds
